Specify individual group transitions

Source: R/group_transition.R
group_transition.Rd

Construct or attach competing origin-to-destination hazards. Only the individual changes group; ancestry, parentage and union histories are retained. Duration is years since the latest recorded transition, or age without one. Missing directed pairs, strata and gaps have zero risk. Restarts retain transition histories and redraw pending events.

Usage

group_transition(rates)

set_group_transition(model, rates)

Arguments

rates

A nonempty data frame requiring group_origin, group_dest, rate, and either age_start/age_end or dur_start/dur_end throughout. Half-open bands use years; rates are finite nonnegative hazards per person-year. Ends may be Inf. Bands cannot overlap within a stratum. Self-transitions are invalid. Optional sex is m/f. Optional union_type is unpartnered/partnered or unpartnered/cohab/marriage. Omitted columns apply universally. Destinations may initially be empty; other configured group-specific processes must cover all possible groups. Optional time_start/time_end specify half-open absolute calendar-year bands, including fractional years. Every active slice must be valid and the table must cover the requested run. Rate changes do not reset group duration.

model

A hammel_model.

Value

group_transition() returns a process with a rates tibble; set_group_transition() returns the updated model. Grouped simulation output always includes a transitions tibble with person_id, time, group_origin, and group_dest, including when empty.
